title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Third Opening Featuring "DIVE TO WORLD" by CHERRYBLOSSOM
content: Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its third opening, featuring the song “DIVE TO WORLD” by CHERRYBLOSSOM. The song was used in Episodes 52-73, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
author: Anime Corner

title: Magic Repo Man Anime's 2nd English-Subtitled Trailer Reveals More Cast, Theme Songs
content: TV Asahi presented the second English-subtitled trailer, another cast member, and the theme song artists for the television anime of Masakichi and Shingou Iijima 's Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I'll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
author: ANN

title: Muse Asia Licenses The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Anime
content: Muse Asia announced last Friday that it has licensed the second television anime season based on Nigojū and Umibōzu 's The Detective Is Already Dead ( Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. ) light novel series and will begin streamming it in October. The anime will debut in Japan on October 7.
author: ANN

title: Ani-One Asia Streams New Magic Knight Rayearth Anime
content: Ani-One Asia announced last Friday that it will stream the new anime of CLAMP 's Magic Knight Rayearth manga in October. Ani-One Asia describes the anime: While visiting Tokyo Tower on a field trip, Hikaru Shidou, Umi Ryuuzaki, and Fuu Hououji are suddenly summoned to another world called Cephiro.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Adds Saga of Tanya the Evil: Operation Desert Pasta Anime Special in India
content: Crunchyroll began streaming in India on Wednesday The Saga of Tanya the Evil: Operation Desert Pasta special . The anime special is streaming in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub . The 17-minute short debuted during a livestreamed event for the franchise in June 2021.
author: ANN

title: 3rd Batch of Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, English Dubs of Naruto Shippūden Anime Stream on Crunchyroll
content: Crunchyroll released the Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu dubs of the anime on July 6 with plans to roll out additional batches of dubbed episodes through September 2026. It began streaming the dubs of episodes 113-175 on August 17.
author: ANN

title: 'Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo, Two Consecutive Cours
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Umikaze Minamino 's Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei naru Musouroku ( Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ) light novel revealed additional cast and the second promotional video on Tuesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Tracksuit Subaru Appears in Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 16 Preview
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 16 (Episode 82 overall) preview ahead of its September 9, 2026 premiere. This will be the fifth episode of the second cour, which is subtitled The Recapture Arc .
author: Anime Corner

title: We Are Aliens Film Streams 'Theme Song Trailer'
content: NOTHING NEW began streaming a "theme song trailer," featuring the song "Sasakure" (Split) by singer adieu, for its We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film with director Kōhei Kadowaki on Tuesday. Kadowaki directed the video, which previews part of the theme song that has not been made public before.
author: ANN
